market.title: Donald Trump — 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls.

text: Trump's odds hit a new high in July when he 'joked' about running for a 'fourth' term as President while donning a Trump 2028 cap at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.
Odds reached 2.9% on Kalshi, but they remain low because according to the 22nd Amendment a President can not serve more than two terms and he has already served two.
Some believe that Trump could utilize a number of constitutional loopholes to serve again, including inheriting the Presidency as Vice President if Vance were to step down.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
